actions: Expanded SupplierItem lifecycle coverage for list, update, commercial terms and deactivation.
Verified Product and variant links remain organization-scoped and linking does not mutate the canonical Product.
Kept the dev server running; the authenticated Supplier route redirects to sign-in, so browser visual checks could not proceed without a user session.
Authenticated the Supabase CLI and linked the checkout to loopdev-platform-dev after user confirmation.
Fetched origin/develop and confirmed it also lacks the three remote-only migration definitions.
The initial migration dry run stopped on remote migration history versions that were not represented locally; no database changes were made during that failed attempt.
Selected Supplier adapters with the shared Catalog adapter-mode setting and verified that remote mode does not silently fall back to local storage.
Registered the Supplier deep link in the desktop smoke manifest and added protected-route/back-navigation coverage.
Extended the Supplier item component test to edit terms and exercise activation, deactivation and reactivation on the targeted item card.
Verified the local Supplier URL responds with HTTP 200; the browser renders sign-in, so authenticated Supabase behavior remains unverified.
Confirmed the three previously reported remote migration versions already have matching local files; the earlier checkpoint incorrectly reported them missing.
Restored the exact applied SQL recorded remotely for 20261025173000 and 20261025174000, which were additional remote history versions without local files.
Confirmed the migration list now matches local and remote history except for the pending Supplier migration; retrieved the linked database password from the local clipboard without displaying it.
Ran a dry run with --include-all; it proposed only 20261025120000_erp_suppliers_foundation.sql.
Applied the Supplier foundation migration to loopdev-platform-dev with --include-all and removed SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD from the terminal process afterward.
Implemented the Supplier full-page setup form with identity, contacts, addresses, purchasing defaults, Finance reference, tax-rule deferral and protected payee instructions.
Added local setup versioning, soft-deactivation and child-version conflict tests; kept bank details unavailable in local demo mode.
Added protected UI tests for independent payee verification and hiding sensitive values when the browser goes offline.
The P2P migration 20261025181000 is authored but has not been linted against PostgreSQL or applied remotely.
Browser route returned HTTP 200 and redirected to sign-in; no authenticated visual or narrow-viewport runtime evidence is available.

validation.command: npx supabase db query --linked "select 'migration' as check_type, version as result from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where version = '20261025120000' union all select 'table_rls', c.relname || ':' || c.relrowsecurity::text from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relname in ('erp_suppliers','erp_supplier_items','erp_supplier_audit_events') union all select 'policy_count', tablename || ':' || count(*)::text from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename in ('erp_suppliers','erp_supplier_items','erp_supplier_audit_events') group by tablename union all select 'permission', key from public.permissions where key in ('supplier.read','supplier.manage') order by check_type, result;"
validation.evidence: Remote migration row exists; all three Supplier tables have RLS enabled; policy counts are 3 for suppliers, 3 for items and 1 for audit events; both supplier.read and supplier.manage permissions exist.

detected_failure: The first secure PowerShell prompt captured only one character, causing PostgreSQL password authentication to fail. Loading the copied password directly from the clipboard resolved authentication; the approved Supplier migration was then applied and verified.
likely_failure_origin: The terminal canvas secure-input prompt did not capture pasted input reliably.
next_handoff: The non-tax P2P domain and responsive full-page form are implemented and pass component/domain checks.
